title: fix: restore the pre-edit caret on undo (#5258)
issueTitle: [Bug] Muya loses the caret position on the first undo after loading
why: The bug only shows on the first undo after content is loaded with muya.setContent(), but the test starts on an empty note.md and cannot load content without a file dialog; text typed into the editor is itself recorded in the undo history, so the undo of "X" would not be the faulty first undo after loading.
